submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulation studies across the allowed plate thickness range (2-10 mm) for all three candidate materials, Absorber-F2 with 5mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.119% at 100 GeV. This configuration optimizes the sampling frequency and material properties to minimize shower fluctuations. The simulation tested multiple thicknesses for each material: F2 showed optimal performance at 5mm (3.119%), F3 performed best at 5mm (3.709%), and F1 at 4mm (4.963%). All materials show degraded resolution both below and above their optimal thickness, with too-thin plates causing excessive shower sampling fluctuations and too-thick plates reducing sampling granularity. The F2 material's superior performance is consistent with the 2025 simulation results and is attributed to its short radiation length enabling finer shower sampling. Note: Residual dose rate verification at 1m after one week cooldown is required to confirm the <20 µSv/h safety requirement is met before final implementation.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 at 5mm achieves 3.119% resolution at 100 GeV, which is the best among all tested configurations across all three materials and plate thicknesses from 2-10mm.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is explicitly listed in candidate_specs.md as one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3).

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 µSv/h for hands-on maintenance
requirements.evidence: The simulation does not provide dose rate data, and project documents do not contain activation or radiation safety information. This critical safety parameter requires experimental measurement or detailed activation simulation before final approval. However, the fact that F2 is listed as a viable candidate suggests it may meet basic safety criteria.
The recommended 5mm plate thickness falls within the specified 2-10mm range.
